title: Polaris Compute Alliance
text:
Polaris Compute Alliance

notes:
Account background: long-term Redwood customer (hosted API since 2023). Current MRR covers embeddings + chat for internal field apps. Team has been piloting Dedicated pool in two edge sites.

Renewal context: annual contract renewal due 2026-05; customer very interested in a Dedicated capacity upgrade (gpu pools + burst) and onboarding Redwood Optimize for batch suggestions. Also evaluating Private deployment in EU region for data residency in EMEA customers.

Key stakeholders: CTO (Anika Patel) - outcome owner; Head of Platform (Carlos Mendez) - cares about cost predictability; Security (Leah Fulton) - running SOC2/ITAR checklist; Procurement (Mark Epps) - handles contracts.

Quotes from last call: "We need predictable throughput for 3rd shift plant sites — burst windows are make-or-break." — Head of Platform. "If Redwood can show clear unit-cost wins with Optimize we can expand to 12 factories by Q4." — CTO.

POC notes: prefix caching + KV cache tests reduced per-token latency by ~18% on site A; customer satisfied with latency p95=220ms for 512-token inference in Dedicated. They want p95 <= 200ms for 256 tokens in 2nd phase.

Security and compliance: asked for HSM-backed KMS proof and audit log retention options (12/24/36 months). Also request for SSO SAML metadata and monthly access reports.

Internal: AE roadmap doc updated, handoff to renewals team planned after pricing sign-off. SE and CSM aligning on onboarding plan for Optimize and EU region switch.

use_case_summary:
Primary workloads: embeddings-based equipment search (heavy indexing, high QPS), on-device field technician chat assistant (low-latency, context window ~6k tokens), and anomaly reranking for sensor streams. Targets: 95th percentile latency <200ms for interactive; throughput burst to 60 requests/sec for scheduled diagnostics; cost sensitivity moderate—wants clear per-factory unit economics. Model preferences: open LLM variants tuned for instruction-following; ability to route to quantized variants for non-critical workloads. Fallback: route to hosted smaller model during Dedicated capacity saturation.

renewal_info:
Current annual contract expires 2026-05-31. Proposal: 12 month renewal + Dedicated upgrade (2 extra GPU nodes reserved per region) + Optimize pilot (6 month). Proposed commercial: 10% discount on committed baseline, tiered burst pricing. Renewal doc uploaded to drive.

next_step:
Finalize renewal pricing and sign Dedicated upgrade addendum; legal routing for data residency addendum

blockers:
internal procurement cycle (Q2 budget approvals)
security review: HSM/KMS attestation pending
network team needs VPC peering diagram

closing_notes:
High trust relationship; we are incumbent for core embeddings/chat. Fast path to close contingent on: 1) clear Optimize ROI showback, 2) HSM/KMS attestation, 3) procurement sign-off on tiered pricing. AE to circulate final commercial by 2026-03-12 and schedule renewal signature meeting.
